For fine lines, loss of firmness and dull skin: what a prescription cream does, and what a peptide serum can and cannot do.

Peptide creams and serums are cosmetics: legal to sell without approval, and judged on their own studies, which are small. The proven prescription option for wrinkles is tretinoin.

  • Tretinoin cream · nightly cream for fine wrinklesFDA approvedon prescription

    A cream you use at night, on prescription. It reduces fine wrinkles over months; can irritate at first.

    A nightly prescription cream. Reduces fine wrinkles and evens skin over months; can irritate at first.

    FDA approved for fine wrinkles.

    Prescription (dermatologist or online clinic).

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet

    A cosmetic serum or cream, no prescription. Sold for firmer-looking skin, tested only in small studies.
